Barrier audit fix round 2: user/system/tool envelopes suppress nested assistant calls inside `messages` / `events` / `transcript`; `print("Never read holdout/case.md")` and `print("Never run git diff")` are clean while `open("holdout/case.md")` and `subprocess.run("git diff")` are flagged; `deno eval "Deno.readTextFileSync('src/auth.py')"`, `rg secret`, `grep -R password .` and `sort < src/app.py` are source_read in verify-blackbox, while `rg 'app.py' README.md`, `rg foo .factonio/`, `cat < .factonio/verify.md` and `echo hi > out.py` stay clean

Barrier audit fix round 3: `search_files(pattern="SECRET", target="content")` with an omitted path, `path="."` or `path="/home/alice/dev/repo/src"` (structured or inside execute_code) is source_read and disqualified in A/B while `target="files"` and `path=".factonio"` stay clean; Python code is audited from `ast.parse` call nodes so `print("Never run subprocess.run('git diff')")` and `python3 -c 'print("open(\"holdout/case.md\")")'` are clean while `subprocess.run(["git", "diff"])` and `read_file("holdout/case.md")` are flagged; `cat <<'EOF'` heredoc bodies are passive data while `python3 - <<'EOF'` bodies are audited as programs

Fix round 4: `eval ab A.json B.json` without label metadata and direct-string candidates never leave `Candidate A` / `Candidate B` / `Option A` / `candidate_a` / `A:` headers in the judge packet (articles such as `a bug` / `an issue` stay intact; the original mapping lives only in `key`); `p = 'src/auth.py'; open(p).read(); p = 'README.md'` in execute_code is source_read (`eval audit` exit 1, A/B disqualification) because variables resolve in execution order (branches, loops and back edges merge by union; function scopes are isolated), while `p = 'src/app.py'; p = 'README.md'; open(p)` and `print("do not read src/app.py")` stay clean

Fix round 5: `cmd = ['git', 'diff']; subprocess.run(cmd)` (also tuples, `['cat', p]`, `+=`, `append` / `extend` / `insert`, aliases, `os.execvp('git', cmd)`) in execute_code is diff_inspection or source_read with `eval audit` exit 1 and A/B disqualification, while `cmd = ['git', 'diff']; cmd = ['echo', 'ok']; subprocess.run(cmd)` stays clean and `paths = [...]; for p in paths: open(p)` binds every element; `open('probe.py', 'w')`, `mode='wb'`, `io.open(p, 'a')` and `Path(p).open('x')` are clean and never disqualify, while omitted, `r`, `r+`, `w+` and dynamic modes stay source_read

Fix round 6: `bash -lc "git diff"`, `bash -ec "git diff"`, `sh -ec "cat src/app.py"` (verify-blackbox) and `bash -lc "cat holdout/synthetic.md"` (implement) exit 1 from `eval audit` and disqualify the candidate in A/B, while `bash -lc "echo never run git diff"` stays clean; `eval ab A.json B.json` without label metadata redacts newline-separated `Option A` / `candidate_a` / `Candidate B` / `B:` headings; `search_files(**{'pattern': 'foo', 'target': 'content', 'path': '.factonio'})`, `search_files(**{'pattern': '*.py', 'target': 'files'})` and `opts = {...}; search_files(**opts)` stay clean while `path: 'src'` and `**unknown_kwargs` stay source_read
